technique_name: Describe a typical day in the life of an NBA player.
description: A typical day in the life of an NBA player begins with waking up in the morning and heading to the practice gym. There they will work on their skills, health and conditioning with their coaches and teammates. After practice they might attend team meetings, review game footage, and consult with medical staff.
